resources.string: Approve the code in Jellyfin to sign in to Seerr. Requires a Seerr version with Quick Connect.
Approve the code in a Jellyfin app where you are already signed in.
Open Jellyfin where you are signed in. Go to Settings → Quick Connect and enter the code. You can also use a browser on this device.
Open Jellyfin on your phone or computer. Go to Settings → Quick Connect and enter the code shown on your TV. Keep this screen open while you approve.
